title: Schur States and Many-Body Quantum Walks on Line Graphs
summary: Let $H$ be a finite simple graph. A one-particle continuous-time quantum walk on its line graph $\ell H$ has one mode for each edge of $H$. This paper is a corrected and reorganized account of that setting. We first record the matrix encoding of an edge-amplitude vector, its Schur state. The encoding is necessarily complex symmetric if it is to be complex linear and to retain the global phase, and it is normalized by $1/\sqrt{2}$.
